audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian — Lucian owning five stages including Level 6 and 2+ items — on a 40% lane whose own prose says 'never all-in him at 6', 'the duel is now his' at first item and 'out-scales your weak ADC-top scaling outright' late.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Lucian, Lucian, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere) matches the whys line for line, including whys[0]'s 'so it's even' at Level 1.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Lucian / Lucian / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere in both layers; tone, diffRating and difficulty prose moved off EVEN to match diff HARD and 40%.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly owned: Lvl 2-3 Lucian's only window, Lvl 6 Undying Rage takeover, 1st item crit spike, Late full scaling. Matches the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The healing is attributed to Spinning Slash and to 'spin-vamp' in four places. Tryndamere's heal is Bloodlust, his Q — a flat 12s that consumes Fury. Spinning Slash (E) does no healing at all in Riot's text.
audit.why: Q: 'He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.' E: 'Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.' The distinction matters because it tells you what to punish: he cannot heal without spending the Fury that is also feeding his crit chance, and the heal is a single flat 12s button that anti-heal shuts down — which is the flagged missing interaction here.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[3], whys[6], spikes[3], late and dosFull[2].d now name Bloodlust.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout is described only as 'his W slow'. Its slow is conditional and nothing says so.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.' The slow only applies while your back is turned — so a Lucian who retreats facing him keeps full move speed and keeps the kite, and one who turns and runs is pinned in Spinning Slash range. That is a free out this page never offers. 850 range, flat 14s. The AD reduction also lands on you regardless of facing, which matters for the trade maths.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, phases[5].why, whys[5], spikes[2] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d tracked only the ult and gave no numbers.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s, Bloodlust a flat 12s, Spinning Slash 12/11/10/9/8s at 650 range. His gap-closer out-ranges Relentless Pursuit's 445, so 'dash out of his spin range' only works if you start the trade outside 650.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: This is lost ground and I treat it that way. By first item his crit spike lets his spin out-DPS my Lightslinger trades, his W slow pins me inside spin range before Relentless Pursuit refreshes, and his vamp out-sustains everything I poke in. By two items he simply out-scales me — I'm a weak scaler for an ADC top and he's a crit-vamp duelist who can't be killed through Undying Rage. So I close this lane on my level 2-3 lead or not at all: I take that window, give up trying to solo him after 6, and pivot to grouping where my Culling and range matter in a fight he can't 1v1 me out of.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Pop Undying Rage' in wants.foe[2] — false positive, correct Riot name. The existing text asserts Undying Rage lasts five seconds and leaves him at 1 HP; Riot's text in the kit file says only that he 'is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes' and gives no duration or HP floor. I did not repeat those specifics in anything I wrote and did not delete the existing claims either — recorded in unverified. Spinning Slash's cooldown reduction on crit is likewise not in the kit text, so I wrote the flat 12/11/10/9/8s and nothing about resets.
